en.headline: Medical Council postpones Chow Tin-yu disciplinary hearing pending inquest
en.dek: The council adjourned the hearing into a Queen Mary Hospital anaesthetist pending a coroner’s inquest, citing overlapping evidence and the need for a fuller factual basis.
body: The Medical Council has postponed a disciplinary hearing into whether a Queen Mary Hospital anaesthetist altered surgical records in the 2020 case that left eight-year-old Chow Tin-yu in a vegetative state, pending a coroner’s inquest.

The hearing had been scheduled for 27 to 30 October. The council said the inquiry panel chairman decided to adjourn after considering the integrity of evidence and procedural fairness. It noted that the disciplinary hearing and the coroner’s inquest concern the same clinical events and overlapping evidence.

The council explained that the coroner’s inquest has broader statutory powers to examine the circumstances of the death, while the disciplinary hearing is limited to specific allegations against the doctor. Proceeding before the inquest ends could risk a decision based on incomplete facts or conflicting findings, it said.

Chow’s father said he was surprised by the last-minute delay and questioned why he was informed only shortly before the original dates, though he agreed that waiting for the inquest could allow a fairer hearing. The council has indicated it will inform the Coroner’s Court of the adjournment.

zh.headline: 醫委會押後周天瑜案紀律研訊 待死因庭完成後再排期
zh.dek: 醫委會指紀律研訊與死因研訊涉及同一臨床事件及重疊證據，押後可避免裁決建基於不完整事實。
body: 醫委會押後一宗涉及瑪麗醫院麻醉科醫生的紀律研訊，有關2020年導致八歲周天瑜陷入植物人狀態的個案，是否涉及更改手術紀錄，待死因庭研訊完成後再作安排。
研訊原定10月27日至30日進行。醫委會表示，研訊小組主席在考慮證據完整性及程序公義後決定押後。當局指紀律研訊與死因研訊涉及同一臨床事件，證據有重疊。
醫委會解釋，死因庭具較廣泛法定調查權，可調查病人離世原因及相關情況，而紀律研訊範圍則限於對涉事醫生的特定指控。若在死因研訊完結前進行，或導致裁決建基於不全面事實，甚至出現不同事實裁斷。
周天瑜父親表示對最後一刻押後感到意外，質疑為何臨近原定日期才通知，但他同意待死因庭完成後或能有更公平的聆訊。醫委會表示會通知死因庭有關押後決定。
